reason: The cited lines show the tool obtaining a Git API connection and reading pull request threads/comments, then returning them as JSON, including comment content and author fields. That supports SECRET because it returns repository/PR SaaS data via the configured connection. It supports UNTRUSTED because PR thread/comment content is user-authored and returned to the agent. The lines show no arbitrary host code execution and no write/send to an attacker-readable destination, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported.
